question: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were actively serving on December 31 of each year from more than 30 years since their first term up to less than 50 years, grouping the results by the exact number of years elapsed since their first term?
sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
legislator_info AS (
    SELECT lt.id_bioguide, l.first_name, l.last_name, lt.term_start, lt.term_end, lt.state
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
),
term_years AS (
    SELECT lt.id_bioguide, lt.term_start, lt.term_end, lt.first_name, lt.last_name,
           date_part('year', CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE)) as start_year,
           date_part('year', CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE)) as end_year,
           ft.first_term_start,
           date_part('year', CAST(ft.first_term_start AS DATE)) as first_term_year
    FROM legislator_info lt
    JOIN first_terms ft ON lt.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
),
year_range AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, first_term_start, first_term_year, start_year, end_year, first_name, last_name,
           UNNEST(generate_series(start_year, end_year - 1, 1)) as year_in_term
    FROM term_years
    WHERE start_year <= end_year - 1
),
years_elapsed_calc AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, first_term_start, first_term_year, year_in_term, first_name, last_name,
           year_in_term - first_term_year as years_elapsed
    FROM year_range
)
SELECT id_bioguide, first_name, last_name, first_term_start, first_term_year, year_in_term, years_elapsed
FROM years_elapsed_calc
WHERE years_elapsed > 30 AND years_elapsed < 50
ORDER BY id_bioguide, years_elapsed
LIMIT 30
